notes: G3 spec (amount+1 on the search count). Printed: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, you may search your library and/or graveyard for A Shrine card and put it onto the battlefield.' Sanctum of All enters; two Shrines are findable: Sanctum of Tranquil Light in the library and Sanctum of Stone Fangs in your graveyard. On your next upkeep the may is taken and Tranquil Light is picked: it enters; Stone Fangs stays in the graveyard.
